title: Proof of Location
tagline: Proof of location. This protocol preserves GPS coordinates on chain, verified Safe with a little help from your fren.
description:
This project is trying to tokenize location information in real world. 

Historically, our human have used to define boundaries for security, ownership, hierarchy using location information, while as of today, we are yet to have it digitized as verified manner.

Location verification, secured GPS coordinates are the missing piece to tokenize everything in our world.

I believe this try of proof of location can be a primitive Proof of Identity without doxxing, If we combined below:
Real world frens
  NFC Tag
  Beacon
  Bluetooth S/N ratio
  AGPS of mobile network
  Our crypto world

Virtual world frens
  Lens
  Gitcoin passport
how_its_made:
Proof of Location is currently built using following:

 1) Retrieve your location from GPS
 2) Ask friends for proof using Safe
 3) Store the proved your coordinates onchain

As a stretch goal, I am planning to add Safe following for confirmation:
  - NFC tag embedded in a wall
  - Beacon information placed at the door
  - Bluetooth signal S/N ratio from other devices
